page_topic_one_liner: Headless CMS guide — API-first content hub (Contentful, Sanity, Storyblok, Strapi, Payload) decoupled from front-end rendering vs website builders and headless browsers
differentiator_vs_generic: Show content API + schema blocks feeding multiple front ends (Web, mobile), NOT drag-and-drop website builder canvas, NOT Playwright browser automation, NOT WordPress theme preview
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Central content schema blocks (title, body, media fields) connected by API arrows to three consumer silhouettes — browser frame, mobile phone, email template
Secondary: Studio/admin panel vignette with structured field list (not WYSIWYG full-page canvas)
Tertiary: Webhook/revalidate dotted line from CMS hub to Next.js page frame labeled SSG/ISR
anti_patterns: Drag-and-drop website builder canvas as hero (that's website-builder)
Real Contentful/Sanity/Storyblok logos — generic CMS blocks only
Ranking badges or numbered product list on image

en.headline: HEADLESS CMS
en.subtitle: API Content Without a Frontend
en.composition: Editorial collage for headless CMS guide. HERO: structured content blocks hub with REST/GraphQL API rays to browser, phone, and email consumer frames. Secondary: generic CMS studio field panel. Tertiary: webhook arrow to Next.js SSG page frame. Title top-left. Paper torn edges. NO builder canvas, NO browser automation, NO vendor logos, NO ranking numbers.
